newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian inmates get hooked up to internet.
newsitem.headline: Italian inmates get hooked up to internet.

text.p: An Italian prison launched an internet site on Wednesday which allows inmates virtual access to the outside world.

Antonio De Lillo, a sociologist involved in the two-year project, said the internet homepage would give prisoners at Milan's San Vittore jail the chance to send stories, poetry, paintings and even musical compositions onto the web.
Inmates will also be able to surf the net but access would be limited by technical surveillance at the jail.
De Lillo said internet points would be gradually introduced to other Italian jails after prison directors and the justice ministry gave the green light to the scheme.
